description.raw: '''Passive:''' While ''Static Field'' is not on cooldown, '''Blitzcrank's''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] apply a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] to the target [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]]. While the target is afflicted, one stack is consumed every 1 second to strike them with lightning, dealing magic damage each time.
description.text: Passive: While Static Field is not on cooldown, Blitzcrank's basic attacks apply a stack to the target on-hit. While the target is afflicted, one stack is consumed every 1 second to strike them with lightning, dealing magic damage each time.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Blitzcrank''' detonates a static field that destroys the damage-mitigating [[File:Hybrid resistances icon.png|20px|link=Shield|An icon representing the keyword Shield]] [[:Shield|shields]] of all nearby enemies, excluding the shields of [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]], and then deals them magic damage and [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Silence|An icon representing the keyword Silence]] [[:Silence|silences]] them for 0.5 seconds.
description2.text: Active: Blitzcrank detonates a static field that destroys the damage-mitigating shields of all nearby enemies, excluding the shields of monsters, and then deals them magic damage and silences them for 0.5 seconds.

notes.raw: * '''Blitzcrank's''' attacks do not have to deal damage to apply the mark. * '''Blitzcrank's''' attacks will not apply a mark if the attack is [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]] or missed while '''Blitzcrank''' is [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blinded]]. ** A mark will still be applied if the attack is [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]]. * The mark will be consumed even if the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]]. * The lightning bolts deal [[File:Disintegrate.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Ability damage]] [[:Damage|spell damage]] while the static field applies [[File:Mega Inferno Bomb.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Area damage]] [[:Damage|area damage]]. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time. * Even if ''Static Field'' is blocked by a [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shield]], it will still destroy any existing damage [[File:Hybrid resistances icon.png|20px|link=Shield|An icon representing the keyword Shield]] [[:Shield|shields]] on the target.
notes.text:
Blitzcrank's attacks do not have to deal damage to apply the mark.
Blitzcrank's attacks will not apply a mark if the attack is dodged or missed while Blitzcrank is blinded.
* A mark will still be applied if the attack is blocked.
The mark will be consumed even if the target becomes untargetable.
The lightning bolts deal spell damage while the static field applies area damage.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
Even if Static Field is blocked by a spell shield, it will still destroy any existing damage shields on the target.
